audits.description: Historical audit runs and compliance snapshots for systems evaluated by GuardianAI.

projectName.description: Name of the audited project or repository.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp string of the audit run.

detectedDomain.description: Domain categorization (e.g. E-Commerce / Retail, Healthcare / BioTech).

activeFrameworks.description: List of active regulatory frameworks (GDPR, PCIDSS, HIPAA, ISO27001, SOC2, HK_PDPO).

status.description: Regulatory posture status (COMPLIANT, LOW RISK, MEDIUM RISK, HIGH RISK, CRITICAL).

schemaText.description: Input architectural specification or SQL DDL.

piiInventory.description: Detected Personally Identifiable Information inventory elements.

remediationTasks.description: Actionable engineering remediation tickets with citations.

toolExecutions.description: Complete execution trace of autonomous tool invocations.

checkedClauses.description: List of statutory articles checked during audit.
